verdict.rationale: Puzzle's ReadMe-hosted API reference has a live per-endpoint "Try It!" console with generated language snippets, synced from a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, so the interactive, runnable reference exists. Running requests needs credentials, API access is request-gated via email, and sandbox credentials are provisioned manually rather than self-serve. Missing for 10: self-serve credentials for running examples, independent or hands-on corroboration that the Try It console works end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The ReadMe-hosted API reference ships the live "Try It!" console per endpoint ("Click Try It! to start a request and see the response here!") with generated language snippets.
it is the sync source for the vendor's ReadMe-hosted developer reference (puzzle-api.readme.io, linked from puzzle.io's llms.txt)
